value.text: To charge the Orion E4 from 20% to 80% using the GridNest W11 at full power, it would take approximately 3 hours and 53 minutes. This is based on the energy calculation of 38.4 kWh required for the charge and the sustained charging power of 11 kW, resulting in a time calculation of 42.67 kWh / 11 kW = 3.88 hours.
